claim: Coarse direction and gain can conceal fine-resolution response-shape distortion
required_evidence: Complete frozen matrix; series-cluster bootstrap; coarse envelope; signed shape distance; resolution gap; matched SQL
acceptance: At least two diverse cells pass the complete predeclared rule and one satisfies the accuracy complement

claim: The metric suite separates shape error from pure gain error
required_evidence: Oracle; gain-only; within-bin shift; cross-bin shift; smoothing; rebound deletion; sign-flip; interaction-omission fixtures
acceptance: All exact identities pass; intended fixture ordering and selectivity checks pass before checkpoint access

claim: Response-shape profiles vary by mechanism and backbone
required_evidence: Every backbone-by-mechanism cell; identical generators; fixed aggregation; all null and adverse cells retained
acceptance: Predeclared interaction summaries and all eight cells are reported without universal-superiority language

claim: Transparent references distinguish task difficulty from TSFM-specific behavior
required_evidence: Ridge-ARX and nonlinear dynamic regression fitted per scenario from context rows only; all eight model-by-mechanism cells retained
acceptance: Reference protocols are identical across mechanisms; fitted and post-primary status is explicit; no primary gate is recomputed
